reviewSamples.author: Nicole DiFalco
reviewSamples.text: We are visiting from out of state for a soccer tournament and needed a place to accommodate our group of 50+ on short notice. They went above and beyond to make it happen! The service was outstanding, and the food was absolutely fantastic. Everyone in our group had a great experience. Highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Bisou Dame
reviewSamples.text: Food is amazing. Chef is the bomb. Food is seasoned well and every bit is delicious. And food is consistently good. Haven't changed in the 1 yr that I have been eating their food. If you haven't had their food make sure you book them for your next event. Promise you won't be disappointed. 😋🤤🤤🤤😋😋😋 …

reviewSamples.author: Hillary N
reviewSamples.text: What a great experience for my staff luncheon. Every raved about the Seafood rice and Lamb chops. The catering services was on time and communicate via email with me during the planning process. Presentation of food was so creative. Thanks again M & D for your services.

reviewSamples.author: Haiti Cherie
reviewSamples.text: Cash Mari, I want to thank you for everything. I purchased from you in March for my birthday party and your food was amazing. My guests love your food.  That was my first time and I will again. She is very professional and her food …

reviewSamples.author: Tom VanDoorne
reviewSamples.text: The food was PHENOMENAL. We are in town and asked them to feed over 50 people on less than 24 hours notice and THEY DELIVERED! Couldn't thank you guys enough. Everyone loved it!
